title: 727. Find K-th Smallest Pair Distance

examples.explanation: Pairs give distances 0, 2 and 2; the smallest is 0.
Distances are 0, 5 and 5, so the third smallest is 5.

hints: Sort first; counting pairs within a distance limit is then a linear two-pointer sweep.
The count grows monotonically with the limit, so binary-search the smallest limit with at least k pairs.
For a fixed right endpoint, all left positions from the low pointer onward form valid pairs.
